title: Millennium Boat House
gap: Prices for boat rentals not stated
blurb: Millennium Boat House offers boat rentals at Millennium Park, including kayaks, canoes, and paddleboards for visitors to enjoy the water. The facility is part of Kent County Parks and provides access to local lakes and trails. Guests can explore the park's natural beauty and recreational opportunities on the water.
extraNote: Millennium Park boat launch area · Summer season, with beach and splashpad opening in mid-May
season: Summer season, with beach and splashpad opening in mid-May
